content.text:
[dependency-groups]
dev = [
    "pre-commit>=3.0.0",
    "ruff>=0.0.280",
    "bandit>=1.7.10",
    "mypy>=1.5.1",
    "pytest>=9.0.3",
    "httpx>=0.23.0",
    "pytz>=2025.2",
    "coverage>=7.10.3",
    "pytest-asyncio>=1.1.0",
    "psycopg[binary]>=3.2.9",
    "pandas>=2.3.2",
    "pylint>=3.3.8",
    "types-pyyaml>=6.0.12.20250915",
    "pandas-stubs>=2.3.2.250926",
    "types-requests>=2.32.4.20250913",
    "pytest-cov>=7.0.0",
]
test = [
    "pre-commit>=3.0.0",
    "ruff>=0.0.280",
    "bandit>=1.7.10",
    "mypy>=1.5.1",
    "pytest>=9.0.3",
    "httpx>=0.23.0",
    "pytz>=2025.2",
    "coverage>=7.10.3",
    "pytest-asyncio>=1.1.0",
    "psycopg[binary]>=3.2.9",
    "pandas>=2.3.2",
    "pylint>=3.3.8",
    "types-pyyaml>=6.0.12.20250915",
    "pandas-stubs>=2.3.2.250926",
    "types-requests>=2.32.4.20250913",
    "pytest-cov>=7.0.0",
]

[build-system]
requires = [
    "uv-build",
]
build-backend = "uv_build"

[tool.uv.build-backend]
module_root = "src/dokumentenpruefung"

[tool.uv.sources.bizlog]
path = "../../03-shared-services/bizlog"

[tool.uv.sources.bmds-ki-logging]
path = "../../03-shared-services/ki-logging"

[tool.uv.sources.bmds-ki-validierung]
path = "../../03-shared-services/ki-validierung"

[tool.uv.sources.bmds-prompt-security]
path = "../../03-shared-services/prompt-security"

[tool.uv.sources.pkg-decision-protocol]
path = "../../03-shared-services/decision-protocol"

[tool.uv.sources.bmds-prompt-loader]
path = "../../03-shared-services/prompt-loader"

[tool.ruff]
exclude = [
    "tests",
]
line-length = 88
target-version = "py312"
extend-exclude = [
    "migrations",
    "__pycache__",
]

[tool.ruff.lint]
select = [
    "E",
    "W",
    "F",
    "I",
    "B",
    "C4",
    "UP",
    "N",
    "YTT",
    "ANN",
    "S",
    "BLE",
    "FBT",
    "B",
    "A",
    "COM",
    "C4",
    "DTZ",
    "T10",
    "DJ",
    "EM",
    "EXE",
    "FA",
    "ISC",
    "ICN",
    "G",
    "INP",
    "PIE",
    "T20",
    "PT",
    "Q",
    "RSE",
    "RET",
    "SLF",
    "SLOT",
    "SIM",
    "TID",
    "TCH",
    "INT",
    "ARG",
    "PTH",
    "TD",
    "FIX",
    "ERA",
    "PD",
    "PGH",
    "PL",
    "TRY",
    "FLY",
    "NPY",
    "RUF",
]
ignore = [
    "D105",
    "D107",
    "UP006",
    "UP007",
    "E501",
    "B008",
    "RUF012",
    "COM812",
]
